svg.aria-label: Illustration: a traffic-control plaza seen from above. Prompts, tool calls, responses and file reads arrive as vehicles in four lanes, pass under the ai-tc policy engine gate, and leave in five lanes: monitor (watched by a camera), warn (a flag), redact (the value on the roof masked as A******E), block (barrier down, lane closed) and exception (set apart, one green vehicle let through).
svg.title: AI Traffic Control
